About these 21 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday has the most, with 8. The earliest start is East Hawaii Riders at 7:00 am; the latest is 808 Lowriders Thursday Night Cruise at 9:00 pm. After work, 2 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 7 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 4. There’s one ride made for women, trans and femme riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 2, 2026.
